lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 131, for issue 129: the details view updates again when files in its folder change.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request one thirty-one, for issue one twenty-nine: the details view updates again when files in its folder change.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what this PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
A one-line upstream fix lets the shown folder's file changes reach the details view, and review fixes make the rest of the handler work.
It starts when a file in the shown folder changes: it grows, or a hidden temp file is renamed.
The folder tells its views that files changed. A rename arrives as a change, not as a new file.
The guard in the tree model now drops only a missing node, so the shown folder gets through.
The row then re-sorts by its new size, or the renamed file leaves the hidden list and appears.
Before this PR, the shown folder has no row and no parent, so the old guard took it for detached and dropped the change.
Each drop logged a line. When those lines filled a pipe nobody read, Thunar froze.
The review found a case this opened up: in search mode, the root's handler gets every changed result.
So the handler now looks each file up in this folder's own rows, and skips the rest.
With Show Hidden on, a file that turns visible and already has a row now re-sorts and redraws.
And when the shown folder's rows re-sort, the view now gets the root's own path.
Upstream 4.20.10 added a safety check that also stopped every change in the folder the details view shows.
lines.say: Upstream four point twenty point ten added a safety check that also stopped every change in the folder the details view shows.

lines.caption: The shown folder is the model's root node, which never has a row or a parent, so the old check always dropped it.
The new guard is upstream's own commit, cherry-picked unchanged from its 4.20 branch.
lines.say: The new guard is upstream's own commit, cherry-picked unchanged from its four twenty branch.

lines.caption: On November 16, 633 of these lines filled a 64 kilobyte pipe, and Thunar hung.
lines.say: On November sixteenth, six hundred thirty-three of these lines filled a sixty-four kilobyte pipe, and Thunar hung.

lines.caption: In search mode, a result renamed to a hidden name now stays listed; before CI's R8 fix it vanished for good.
lines.say: In search mode, a result renamed to a hidden name now stays listed; before CI's R eight fix it vanished for good.

lines.caption: This lookup replaces the local review's parent check, which found no search results at all.
Before, the handler stopped once the file left the hidden list, so its row kept the old name.
The old path made the view reorder the first row's children, or nothing. Upstream has the same bug.
The change: a narrower guard, a lookup in the folder's own rows, and the root path for a reorder.
The same commit also fixes a per-file flag and two stale item counts; CI's own fix adds one for search results.
Both details view modes use the tree model, so both lost changes in the shown folder.
The icon and compact views use a different model, and were never affected.
The PR changes one source file, adds one verify script, and adds this page and its narration.
To undo, revert the squash commit; the next upstream release brings the same guard line anyway.
Part 2. How it was built and verified.
The PR was built and tested before the review fixes. CI then built the final head, with every fix, and passed all 26 tests.
lines.say: The PR was built and tested before the review fixes. CI then built the final head, with every fix, and passed all twenty-six tests.

lines.caption: The fix is upstream's commit for its issue 1884, from the 4.20 maintenance branch.
lines.say: The fix is upstream's commit for its issue eighteen eighty-four, from the four twenty maintenance branch.

lines.caption: The owner's own reproduction, and the icon view's model, show what correct behaviour looks like.
The new test sorts the details view by size, and runs once with Expandable Folders off and once on.
It grows the smallest file, and requires that the first row changes.
It renames a hidden temp file to x.txt, and requires that x.txt is listed.
lines.say: It renames a hidden temp file to x dot text, and requires that it is listed.

lines.caption: And Thunar's log must have no detached node line. The test takes eight shots.
In a cloud container, the build passed, 25 of 25 tests passed, and the new test passed in 34 seconds.
lines.say: In a cloud container, the build passed, twenty-five of twenty-five tests passed, and the new test passed in thirty-four seconds.

lines.caption: CI's build of the final fixes passed 26 of 26 tests; the audit of its screenshots is still to come.
lines.say: CI's build of the final fixes passed twenty-six of twenty-six tests; the audit of its screenshots is still to come.

lines.caption: Not run: the test against the old build, the original freeze, and the search mode and Show Hidden fixes, R8 and R9 included.
lines.say: Not run: the test against the old build, the original freeze, and the search mode and Show Hidden fixes, R eight and R nine included.

lines.caption: A fresh review agent found one bug and fixed it, and skipped three findings.
The bug was the search-results case. CI's lookup fix in step 8 replaces that check.
lines.say: The bug was the search-results case. CI's lookup fix in step eight replaces that check.

lines.caption: A hidden file renamed while Show Hidden is on kept its old row. CI's review found it too, and step 9 fixes it.
lines.say: A hidden file renamed while Show Hidden is on kept its old row. CI's review found it too, and step nine fixes it.

lines.caption: A stale comment stays as upstream has it, and the missing explainer is this page.
CI's review of the first push found seven findings, but its own fix commit never got pushed.
CI's review of the fix round found three more, and this time its own fix commit for R8 and R9 was pushed.
lines.say: CI's review of the fix round found three more, and this time its own fix commit for R eight and R nine was pushed.

lines.caption: You accepted R7 and R10, the stale comment and log message, so those lines still match upstream and merge cleanly.
lines.say: You accepted R seven and R ten, the stale comment and log message, so those lines still match upstream and merge cleanly.

lines.caption: The two medium ones: a file turning visible with Show Hidden on, and a stale item count in the status bar.
Four low ones are fixed too: a flag reset, search results, top-level folder counts, and the test's paste wait.
R7 and R10 are accepted; R8 and R9, both in search mode, are fixed by CI's own commit.
lines.say: R seven and R ten are accepted; R eight and R nine, both in search mode, are fixed by CI's own commit.

lines.caption: The building session also fixed the root reorder path, which the review didn't flag.
Your own folders, and days of use without a freeze, can only be checked once you install the next build.
The PR, the issue, the upstream commit and CI's screenshots are all linked here.
Part 3. What comes later.
No open issue depends on this one. The next upstream release already has the guard fix, and the guard's lines still match it.
The weekly watcher will merge the next release, which has the same guard line.
You accepted R7 and R10, which keeps the guard's lines as upstream has them for that merge.
lines.say: You accepted R seven and R ten, which keeps the guard's lines as upstream has them for that merge.

lines.caption: The guard line should merge without a conflict; the review fixes are ours, and conflict only if upstream edits those lines.
R7 and R10: the guard's comment still says detached node, and you chose to keep it as upstream has it.
lines.say: R seven and R ten: the guard's comment still says detached node, and you chose to keep it as upstream has it.

lines.caption: The Show Hidden and root reorder follow-ups are gone, because this PR now fixes both.
In short: the details view sees file changes in its own folder again, and Thunar stops flooding its log.
